paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Adda, of Yaffo: Shocher Tov, section 62; Midrash Rabbah, Behar, section 33; Bereshit Rabbah, section 38; and Chazit, on “My vineyard is before me.” Jerusalem Talmud, Megallechin, halakhah 7, has “son of Rav Adda of Yaffo”; Jerusalem Megillah, chapter 3, halakhah 8, “son of R. Adda of Yaffo,” in R. Zeira's name.
